podcasts.name: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Drive 'Em Down Hall's Influence on Champion Jack Dupree
podcast.body: Drive 'Em Down Hall not only composed "Juncker's Blues" but also taught Champion Jack Dupree his distinctive piano style, deeply influencing Dupree's musical approach. "Dupree heard the song from Hall, who also apparently taught Dupree his piano style."
